description: This file defines interfaces and utility classes for formatting and resolving options within the Orleans framework, particularly for configuration and logging. It includes interfaces for formatting options objects, resolving specific formatters based on option names, and utility methods for formatting key-value pairs and option names.

classes.name: IOptionFormatter
classes.description: An interface for formatting options objects into collections of string representations, providing a category and name for options.

classes.name: IOptionFormatter<T>
classes.description: A generic interface extending IOptionFormatter, for formatting specific types of options.

classes.name: IOptionFormatterResolver<T>
classes.description: An interface for resolving specific option formatters for given option types and names.

classes.name: OptionFormattingUtilities
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for formatting key-value pairs and option names with default formatting.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a key-value pair into a string using a specified or default format.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Formats the name of an options object, optionally including custom formatting.
